# London Calendar — London's big dates for the year ahead

> The fixed points of the London year, published as soon as their organisers fix the dates. Every entry names the source it came from and the day it was checked against it. Published by GB7 (gb7.uk). Independent: not a government outlet, not a ticket seller, not affiliated with any venue.

How this site works, in five rules:

- **Every fact names where it came from, and when we last looked.** The source prints as text, never as a live link.
- **Nothing is listed on a date we could not confirm.** A date that has only been reported, and not published by the organiser, waits.
- **What's on, not what went wrong.** No politics, no crime, no tragedy.
- **We pick the best, and say why.** Picking out the best of something is the job; running a named business down is not.
- **A page exists when there is something to put on it.** No empty templates waiting for content.

## What a reader finds here

- [Events](https://l0n.uk/events/): the year's big London dates, in date order, with times, prices and the ticket release where the organiser published them.
- [News](https://l0n.uk/news/): dates as they are fixed and tickets as they go on sale.
- [About](https://l0n.uk/about/): the rules above, written out at length.

## Where the facts come from

The organisers themselves: the Mayor of London, the Boat Race, London Marathon Events, the Royal Horticultural Society and the rest. Each entry prints that name and the date it was verified. What has not been announced is said to be unannounced.

## Events

- [Wimbledon 2027: the 150th Championships](https://l0n.uk/events/wimbledon-2027/): The Championships 2027 at Wimbledon, London, run from 28 June to 11 July — the 150th anniversary year. The public ballot has closed; the Queue sells Centre, No.1 and No.2 Court tickets on the day, 500 each, and Grounds Passes.
- [Serendipity Arts Festival London 2027](https://l0n.uk/events/serendipity-arts-festival-london-2027/): A new nine-day festival of art from India and its diaspora takes over Exhibition Road and South Kensington's museums in London from 19 to 27 June 2027 — the V&A, Science Museum, Natural History Museum and Royal Albert Hall among the partners.
- [Meltdown 2027, curated by FKA twigs](https://l0n.uk/events/meltdown-2027-fka-twigs/): The Southbank Centre's artist-curated festival returns to London from 10 to 20 June 2027 under FKA twigs, its 32nd curator, with dozens of concerts, two free weekends and a one-off headline show of her own; line-up and tickets in spring.
- [GALA 2027, Peckham Rye Park](https://l0n.uk/events/gala-2027/): London's independent south London dance festival returns to Peckham Rye Park over the late May bank holiday, 28–30 May 2027, with Four Tet, HAAi and DJ Harvey in the first wave; presale from 10am on 30 October 2026.
- [RHS Chelsea Flower Show 2027](https://l0n.uk/events/chelsea-flower-show-2027/): RHS Chelsea Flower Show 2027 runs 18 to 22 May at the Royal Hospital Chelsea in London: members' days Tuesday and Wednesday, public days Thursday to Saturday, tickets from £61.
- [London Marathon 2027 over two days](https://l0n.uk/events/london-marathon-2027/): The 2027 London Marathon is a one-off two-day event: Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 April, 100,000 participants, and the same course from Greenwich to Westminster on both days.
- [The Boat Race 2027](https://l0n.uk/events/boat-race-2027/): The Boat Race 2027 is on Sunday 11 April on the Thames in London, Putney to Mortlake: the men's race at 3.40pm, then the women's at 4.40pm as the final race.
- [England's Six Nations 2027 home games at Twickenham](https://l0n.uk/events/six-nations-2027-england-at-twickenham/): England play three Guinness Men's Six Nations matches at Allianz Stadium, Twickenham, in south-west London in 2027: France on Sunday 14 February at 15:10, Italy on Saturday 20 February at 16:40, and Scotland for the Calcutta Cup on Saturday 13 March at 16:40.
- [Philip Glass at 90, Southbank Centre](https://l0n.uk/events/philip-glass-at-90-southbank-2027/): The Southbank Centre marks Philip Glass's 90th birthday weekend in London on 30 and 31 January 2027: Music in 12 Parts in full, four string quartets from Brooklyn Rider, Manchester Collective, and the UK premiere of Symphony No.15 on the day itself, from £22.
- [London New Year's Eve fireworks 2026](https://l0n.uk/events/new-years-eve-fireworks-london-2026/): The Mayor of London's New Year's Eve fireworks on the Thames, 31 December 2026: gates 8pm to 10.30pm, tickets from £20 for Londoners, first release at noon on Friday 23 October.
- [Duran Duran: The Danse Macabre Halloween Party at The O2](https://l0n.uk/events/duran-duran-danse-macabre-halloween-o2-2026/): Duran Duran end their UK arena tour with their first Halloween show in London: The Danse Macabre Halloween Party at The O2 on Saturday 31 October 2026, doors 6.30pm, fans encouraged to dress up, and a set of twisted hits, deep cuts and rarities. Tickets through AXS, The O2's official partner.

## News

- [London's big dates for 2027: what the organisers have fixed so far](https://l0n.uk/news/london-big-dates-2027-so-far/): New Year's Eve tickets on 23 October, the Boat Race on 11 April, a two-day Marathon on 24 and 25 April and Chelsea from 18 May: the London dates their organisers have fixed.
